units.source_text: 我没有再次去"大泷"，该做的事已经完成。

en.t: I did not go to "Otaki" again; what had to be done was already finished.

units.source_text: 剩下的只有待老师发现他给我的学费的用途，把我驱逐出寺庙。

en.t: All that remained was to wait for my teacher to discover how I had used the tuition money he had given me, and to expel me from the temple.
